categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of electronic components, focusing on IC substrate products including PBGA, MCM BGA, CSP substrates, Flip Chip substrates, and embedded substrates. It also has an optical division contributing to its product portfolio. The business is divided mainly into the substrate (77.68% of sales) and optical segments (22.32%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced IC substrate manufacturing technologies such as multi-layer build-up, fine pitch copper pillar, embedded passive and active components, high-frequency materials, and thin core layer processes. It focuses on high-density wiring, microvias, low shrinkage materials, and high thermal dissipation substrates. Production includes processes like drilling, lamination, plating, and automated optical inspection, with ongoing R&D in ultra-fine lines, embedded components, and glass core substrates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are IC packaging, IC design, and system companies globally, particularly in the semiconductor and electronics sectors. Major end markets include servers/data centers, mobile phones, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and industrial applications. The company targets high-performance computing and AI-related applications, with customers mainly from the US, Taiwan, China, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with multiple manufacturing sites and sales offices. Its sales distribution includes Taiwan (27.83%), China (21.79%), the United States (17.65%), Japan (13.04%), and other regions (19.69%). It also has subsidiaries and investments in the USA, Samoa, Cayman Islands, China, Japan, Vietnam, and Singapore.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a manufacturer of IC substrates, which serve as essential components for semiconductor packaging and assembly. It sources raw materials like copper foil and specialty chemicals from upstream suppliers and sells to downstream IC packaging and EMS companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding ABF FC-BGA substrate capacity, developing multi-chip packaging, high-frequency and high-speed materials, and glass core substrates for optical co-packaging. R&D focuses on ultra-low shrinkage materials, fine pitch copper pillars, embedded passive/active components, ultra-fine wiring, and automated thin board production. The company aims to maintain technology leadership and meet AI and 5G/6G market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of IC substrates and optical components. The company sells to semiconductor packaging and design firms on a contract basis, with revenue tied to volume and product mix. It also benefits from long-term strategic investments and licensing arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes globally with Japanese firms like Ibiden and Shinko, Korean firms such as SEMCO and LGI, and other Taiwanese players like Unimicron and Nanya PCB. It holds over 35% market share in the global IC substrate market and is recognized for its full-process manufacturing capabilities and strong customer relationships, especially in US server and mobile markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$30.5 billion, a 13.8% increase year-over-year, with net profit rising 13.7%. The IC substrate market is growing at a CAGR of 7.6% (2023-2028), driven by AI and high-performance computing demand. The company invests heavily in R&D (over 8% of revenue) and capital expenditures to expand capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology leadership, high product quality, and customer satisfaction to differentiate itself. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio with advanced substrate technologies, including high-layer count ABF substrates and embedded components. Its full-process manufacturing and early customer engagement in new product development create high entry barriers for competitors and ensure alignment with evolving market needs.
